items.title: Document the canonical owner-session contract
items.context: Define LATTICE_SESSION_ID as the core owner lease identity, separate host-specific session env from core owner lease logic, and explain why ppid-derived identity is only a last-resort fallback.
items.userSees: User sees the execution plan state: LATTICE_SESSION_ID is the canonical owner lease identity; host-specific session variables are bridged before core owner lease logic; ppid is last-resort degraded fallback only.

happy.desc: The created execution plan states that LATTICE_SESSION_ID is the canonical owner lease identity used by core owner-session logic, and linked contract docs repeat that host-specific session variables must be bridged before core lease handling.

edge.desc: The plan documents degraded identity behavior: ppid-derived identity is allowed only as a last-resort fallback when LATTICE_SESSION_ID is absent, and the user-visible source should make that degraded fallback clear.

adversarial.desc: A reviewer challenges a parent-PID-changing invocation path and the documentation still requires stable ownership through LATTICE_SESSION_ID, with ppid fallback treated as non-canonical and insufficient for the normal multi-host contract.

items.title: Define host adapter bridge and future-host onboarding rules
items.context: Specify how Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity/agy, and future hosts bridge stable native session identifiers into LATTICE_SESSION_ID without adding host-specific special cases to owner lease core.
items.userSees: User sees the execution plan host adapter section: Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity/agy, and future hosts all bridge native or generated session ids into LATTICE_SESSION_ID without new owner-lease core special cases.

happy.desc: The execution plan defines a host adapter bridge table or equivalent section for Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity/agy, and future hosts, with each host producing or forwarding a stable value into LATTICE_SESSION_ID before owner lease logic runs.

edge.desc: The plan gives onboarding rules for hosts that lack a native stable session variable: generate or map a host-local stable session id in the adapter layer, export it as LATTICE_SESSION_ID, and document the source shown to users.

adversarial.desc: The plan explicitly forbids adding Codex, Claude, agy, or future host special cases to core owner lease code; host-specific variables are resolved only by adapters before the core sees LATTICE_SESSION_ID.

items.title: Define verification and rollout plan with two-host review
items.context: Specify tests and smoke coverage for ppid-changing command invocations, wrapper env bridging, owner lease refresh behavior, session_brief source rendering, and independent 2-host review evidence before implementation proceeds.
items.userSees: User sees the execution plan rollout section: implementation must include ppid-changing regression smoke, wrapper/dispatch bridge checks, session_brief source rendering, and two-host review evidence before runtime changes ship.
